newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Shantou ITIC sets US$20 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: China's Shantou ITIC sets US$20 mln FRCD.

text.p: A US$20 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue for Shantou International Trust and Investment Corp has been launched, sole arranger ANZ Bank Hong Kong said on Monday.
The facility has a tenor of six months and can be extended for a further six months. It pays a margin of 50 basis points per annum over the London Interbank Offered Rate.

Management fees are 40 basis points for lead managers committing US$5 million or more, 37.5 basis points for managers committing between US$3 million and US$5 million and 35 basis points for co-managers committing less than US$3 million.
Identical renewal fees will be paid at the end of the six-month period if the facility is automatically extended.
The facility will be approved by China's State Administration for Exchange Control (SAEC), ANZ Bank said.
